title: 3dglasses and interesting take on Gaudi and Barcelona 1884
text: It is like a Disney ride where your seat moves ( quite a bit) and the 3 d glasses make it seem like objects are heading towards you and you are flying into space. If this makes you queasy this ride is not for you however it was really interesting and it tried to depict what might’ve been going on in Gaudi‘s mind when he created all his fantastic structures and buildings.
author: Lisa_M

title: Beautiful experience
text: Excellent activity that allows you to enjoy the beauty of Barcelona in a different way! Understanding how and what Gaudi thought is a must if you visit this city.
author: soledad_2016

title: Recommended with children.
text:
Very nice to get the story along. A little short.
I'd do it like we did beforehand tour town. Then kids recognize the works / buildings etc earlier.
author: peggybW4985VE

title: Nice surprise
text:
We arrived by chance and the experience surprised me. Besides being fun, I highly recommend it before or after visiting Gaudi's houses and monuments. It helps you get into his head and understand his works
It is also very refreshing to go after visiting Park Güell. You come all hot and it cools you down
author: 852patriciae

title: Fun and didactic before Park Guell
text: It was super fun and we had a great time before going to Park Guell! It allows us to understand the inspiration of Gaudi for his works. I recommend it
author: Y5394MVjosepg

title: A Disney worthy 4D attraction of Gaudi life
text: A 4D presentation of life of Gaudi. Got a taste of what Barcelona was like in his time.Presentation production values very good. Disney like theme park emersion presentation. In a hilly part of town. No taxi service there but  a several block walk. Easier access from Park Guell lower exit to this attraction.
author: George_B

title: short but inspiring experience
text: We stumbled upon this place by chance on our way back from Park Güell on a very hot day. It seemed like a great opportunity to take a break and cool off, but it offered so much more. First of all, the staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. It was thrilling to see Gaudí's genius and the history of his legacy to Barcelona in a 10-minute 4D film. It may be short, but it's worthwhile in inspiring further exploration. It's definitely an experience everyone, young and old, will enjoy. The price is also quite reasonable.
author: Fenerlady

title: Worth a visit for sure.
text: For the price you pay it is well worth going in. The staff are friendly and helpful. It's a virtual experience 3D show. The films shown give you a great perspective of Barcelona and what Gaudi may have used for his creations
author: Dale H

title: Great!
text:

A projection of Gaudí’s view, in pictures so that everyone can understand! 
To do!

title: Gaudí Experiència
text: Gaudí Experiència in Barcelona is a cool and memorable experience to learn and see all things Gaudi. I really enjoyed everything and it was well worth it for everything that they have available here.
